Schedule

CSS 173 · Fundamentals of Programming Theory and Applications · Winter 2027draft

Winter 2027 · Section A · Monday/Wednesday 5:45–7:45 PM · UW1 051 · SLN 13199

Programming is taught through two kinds of information-systems work: analyzing business data (Part I) and automating the management of files (Part II). Each session is 120 minutes.

Quarter Dates

  • Instruction: Mon Jan 4 – Fri Mar 12, 2027
  • Holidays (no class): Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Mon Jan 18; Presidents' Day, Mon Feb 15
  • Finals week: Mar 15–19, 2027

The two Monday holidays leave 18 sessions.
